summary: One line: who this host is and what they look like. Faces are drawn blank; eyes, nose and mouth are swapped on top.

sources._: One entry per sprite sheet in sources/, e.g. "poses": "sources/poses.png". Replace this line.

face_detect._: How each pose's blank face is found. skin: the face's colour range on these sheets (sample it from reference.png); remove the key for the default warm skin range. mode 'manual': no detection, every pose needs a face_overrides entry.

face._: Placement, as shares of each pose's face width. The beard line is where face skin ends below its centre: the chin on a clean-shaven host, so mouth_y goes negative (about -0.25) to sit the mouth above it. Tune with the model sheet's face guides.

expressions._: eyes: [left, right]; 'mirror' flips the left piece. tilt: degrees, positive raises the inner brow (sad), negative lowers it (angry). pose is the default body for this feeling; any pose takes any expression. Twelve is a good set: neutral, happy, delighted, excited, surprised, sad, angry, skeptical, thinking, worried, confident, unimpressed. neutral is required.

visemes._: Mouth shape per sound group, after the classic animation chart. rest is the closed mouth between phrases. All ten are needed for lip-sync.

etc.sounds: c d g k n r s t y z

limits._: What this host cannot do yet, shown on its model sheet. One entry per limit.
